title: Let Naam make the heart whole before anyone approves
summary: The shabad repeats “perfect” until wholeness is relocated from circumstance into the heart where Naam lives. Standing is safest when completeness is received there first.
takeaway: Let Naam make the heart whole before anyone approves.
lifeApplication: Before defending your name, stand still for one breath and remember where perfection is kept: not in the crowd’s verdict, but in Naam held within.

source.shortMeaning: The path, cleansing, and everything become whole when Naam is kept in the heart.
source.lifeApplication: Before defending your name, return to the wholeness Naam gives within.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad makes inner Naam the place where incompleteness is healed into wholeness.
evidence.turn: Let the heart receive completeness before the public self seeks it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before defending your name, stand still for one breath and remember where perfection is kept: not in the crowd’s verdict, but in Naam held within.
